About.title: Where Heritage Meets the Present
About.intro: GABR is not just a fragrance house — it's a journey that begins deep in the Arabian desert and ends on your skin.
About.paragraph1: GABR was founded by a family steeped in the craft of perfumery, passing down the secrets of distillation and aging through generations. Every bottle carries decades of expertise and an obsession with detail.
About.paragraph2: We travel to the world's finest sources — Cambodian oud, Taif rose, Indian Ocean amber — selecting only what is worthy of the GABR name.
About.paragraph3: Today, we offer that legacy in a contemporary voice, for a generation seeking authenticity without giving up modernity.
About.value1Body: Every fragrance is hand-composed under the guidance of perfumers with over two decades of expertise.
About.value2Body: We import the finest raw materials from their original sources around the world.
About.value3Body: High concentrations give our fragrances a presence that lasts from morning to evening.
About.quote: A fragrance is not just a scent — it's a memory we craft to last.

Contact.title: We'd Love to Hear From You
Contact.intro: Questions about your order, our fragrances, or anything else — we're here. Reach out however suits you best and we'll get back to you shortly.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: By using the GABR Perfumes website, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before placing an order.
Terms.section1Body: All prices shown on the site are in Egyptian Pounds and include applicable tax. We reserve the right to change prices or product availability at any time without prior notice. An order is considered confirmed once you complete checkout.
Terms.section2Body: We offer payment via InstaPay, Vodafone Cash, or Cash on Delivery, depending on availability at the time of your order. For electronic payments, please attach proof of transfer at checkout to speed up confirmation.
Terms.section3Body: We deliver to every governorate in Egypt. Shipping cost is calculated automatically based on the governorate you select and shown clearly before you confirm your order. Delivery times vary by governorate, and we'll reach out via WhatsApp to confirm delivery details.
Terms.section4Body: You can request to cancel an order before it ships by contacting us directly via WhatsApp or email. If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, contact us within 48 hours of delivery and we'll resolve it, whether by replacement or refund.
Terms.section5Body: All content on this site — logo, design, images, and text — is owned by GABR Perfumes and may not be used or reproduced without prior written consent.
Terms.section6Body: For any questions about these terms, reach out via the contact details on our Contact page.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what data we collect from you and how we use it when you browse or shop on the GABR Perfumes website.
Privacy.section1Body: When you place an order, we collect your name, phone number, email, address, and governorate to fulfill and deliver it. For electronic payments, we may ask for proof of transfer. When you create an account, we only keep your name and email.
Privacy.section2Body: We use your data exclusively to fulfill your orders and contact you about them (via WhatsApp or phone), respond to your inquiries, and improve your experience on the site. We never use your data for marketing without your consent.
Privacy.section3Body: The site uses your browser's local storage to keep your cart and wishlist between visits. This data stays on your device and is only sent to us when you complete an order.
Privacy.section4Body: We never sell or rent your data to any third party. Delivery details are shared only with whoever fulfills the shipment, solely to get your order to you.
Privacy.section5Body: We take reasonable technical measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, including password encryption and secured connections to the site.
Privacy.section6Body: You can request to view, correct, or delete the data we hold about you at any time by reaching out via the contact details on our Contact page.
